name: メッセージ再通知の時刻候補
prompt:
Refine candidate 1 to match the original source crop more closely. Keep its correct Japanese title and all six option strings, the white rounded-top sheet, and the source's original modal framing.

Add the clearly visible thin pale-gray horizontal divider directly below the title/header, spanning the sheet width. Candidate 1 omitted this source divider. Keep only this header divider and the divider above the final 「日時を指定」 row; do not add separators between the first five quick choices, because the original screenshot has none there (the native preview's extra row dividers are secondary). Narrow the centered gray drag handle to about 44px on the 390px-wide canvas. Preserve the original rounded corner radius and the dark dimmed background only in the small areas outside the rounded top corners.

Keep exact text:
Title 「リマインダーを設定」
「30分後」
「1時間後」
「3時間後」
「明日の9:00」
「月曜日の9:00」
Final row 「日時を指定」

Keep the target at 390×306. Use a white #FFFFFF modal, near-black #1D1D1D text, a #D7D7D7 handle, and #E4E4E4 hairline dividers. Preserve Meiryo typography and source row spacing. No picker wheel, submit button, Slack message content, background hyperlink, status bar or footer. No option is a hyperlink. The actual blue Youtube link in the full source is above and outside the crop; do not add it to this isolated modal.
reviewNotes: Second candidate includes the source header divider, correct handle and exact Japanese options; small top-corner scrim tonal difference remains.
